name: Kazoe Books App
description: Kazoe Books App is a clean, focused WordPress theme designed for retail bookkeeping and small shop SaaS landing pages. Featuring signature stepped label-box headings, structured pricing tables, and responsive feature rows, it communicates counter workflows with clarity. Built for independent businesses, it delivers a calm and professional digital presence.
deviation: Stage 1 (home, en). Reference recruit.smarthr.co.jp: stepped white label-box headings, top/bottom halves first screen with 3px dither gradient, numbered rows with 80px number column and ink plus box, fixed bottom-right CTA pair.

fonts.role: display headings, numbers, buttons (variable, Latin subset)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2020 The Plus Jakarta Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans)

summary.en: A bookkeeping app landing page: stepped label-box headlines over a dither-gradient split hero, numbered feature rows, pricing table and FAQ.
